entries.b7c33be410e971b5: This is branding support that formulates recruitment concepts and messages and produces creative tools such as videos, WEB sites and graphics used in recruitment, conveying the appeal of companies to the people targeted for recruitment and linking it to hiring. When deciding the recruitment concept, the company uses its proprietary survey tool 'Bizumiru Survey' to examine its brand image among students and clarify its strengths and appeal compared with competitors. Based on this, the company proposes a communication strategy that involves producing recruitment sites, videos, brochures and the like to draw attendees to recruitment briefings and increase visitors to its WEB sites. Revenue for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥526,165 thousand (down 1.4% year on year).
entries.b8475f9cb59447c6: Support for defining a company's philosophy and values and encouraging employees to take them in and identify with them. It objectively surveys employees' attitudes toward their work and draws up a plan based on the results. It picks up on anxieties and dissatisfactions, puts the company's reason for existing into words, reviews the code of conduct, creates credo cards bearing the philosophy and code of conduct, conveys them using video and other media at presentations such as kickoff meetings, and also carries out work such as renewing the corporate website.
entries.bfabfbb8333fb633: This is a business providing branding support services specialized in human capital management (management that raises corporate productivity through investment in people), mainly for large companies, and it is the company's sole reportable segment. The securities report defines companies with 100 or more employees as 'large corporate group' and states that the company has served approximately 1,000 companies as clients in total. The company cites as its strength being a 'companion' that can provide, in an integrated and continuous cycle, consultation to identify branding challenges and formulate strategies, production of videos, WEB sites, brochures and other materials, and resolution of issues. For the fiscal year ended September 2025, revenue was ¥1,547,053 thousand (down 0.9% year on year), operating loss was ¥73,617 thousand, and net loss for the year was ¥63,649 thousand. The securities report explains that because the first half focused on meeting delivery deadlines for existing projects, winning new projects from the second half onward temporarily stalled, and personnel hired with future growth in mind also took time to become fully productive. The business is divided into two areas: corporate support and recruiting support.
